profile.name: Timepix/SPIDR像素探测器采集系统
profile.description: 用于连接SPIDR并初始化、控制一个或多个Timepix像素探测器的采集系统，可设置偏置电压、启动或停止采集、通过轮询或回调接收数据，并将采集数据记录到文件。
profile.description_en: An acquisition system for connecting to SPIDR and initializing and controlling one or more Timepix pixel detectors. It supports bias voltage control, starting and stopping acquisition, receiving data by polling or callback, and recording acquired data to files.
